title: Implications of the First JUNO Results for Dirac Neutrino Texture Zeros
summary: Motivated by the first oscillation results from JUNO, we study the phenomenological viability of texture zeros in the Dirac neutrino mass matrix. The improved precision on the solar mixing angle $\sin^2{θ_{12}}$ and the solar mass-squared difference $Δm_{21}^2$ provide a stringent probe for scrutinizing predictive texture zero frameworks. We perform a systematic scan of the allowed parameter space for two-zero textures, identifying sharp correlations among oscillation observables arising from the reduced parameter space.
